battle.name: 押赤城之戰
battle.brief: 蒙古帝國兀良合台在忽必烈班師後留鎮雲南，秋七月先在羅部府大破高昇於夷可浪山，進逼大理東都押赤城：石砲轟北門、火攻焚門皆不克，遂連震鼓鉦七日以疲守軍，夜五鼓令子阿朮潛師躍入亂斫，大理軍潰，追至昆澤擒國主段智興。希臘火與本役無涉，攻城全憑砲攻、火攻與夜襲。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 押赤城之戰的交戰方是蒙古帝國與大理國。蒙古方面是憲宗四年由忽必烈率領的征雲南軍：忽必烈自統中道，大軍抵忒刺後分三路進取，西道交兀良合台去攻白蠻，東道交諸王素赫，輜重留滿陀城，隊伍過大渡河後沿山谷行二千餘里至金沙江，以吹脹的革囊和木筏分批渡江，渡點在大理城北四百餘里。1254年春忽必烈班師返京兆，兀良合台以總督軍務留滇，招撫未附的白蠻、黑蠻諸部。他的部隊以蒙古本部騎兵為骨幹，配漢地徵發的步卒、匠人與攻城將士，軍中設千戶、把總分層，攻城器械由隨軍工匠隊維護。大理一方是白族段氏政權，名義上的國主是段智興，實權握在相國高氏手中，高泰祥掌樞機，族人高昇領羅部府諸部兵；大理國以白蠻、黑蠻諸部的武裝為兵源，有象騎、有弓弩手，滇池東岸的押赤城即拓東城，是大理控扼雲南東部的軍事重鎮。同一戰線上西道兵正在逐一攻下白蠻的寨柵，半空和寨依山枕江，最後是靠切斷汲道才攻破。押赤城城際滇池、三面皆水，大理等於以整片湖面作外壕，守城方以水為依托，攻守之別先決於能不能渡水登岸。
countriesEn: The belligerents in the Battle of Aizai were the Mongol Empire and the kingdom of Dali. On the Mongol side stood the expedition to Yunnan led by Kublai in the fourth year of Möngke's reign. Kublai took the central column himself, and after the army reached Terchi it split three ways: Urankhadai was given the western column to work against the Baiman, the prince Suhe took the eastern column, and the heavy baggage was left at the depot of Mantuo. After crossing the Dadu the host marched more than two thousand li through the gorges to the Jinsha River, where it crossed in batches on inflated leather bags and timber rafts, at a point some four hundred li north of the city of Dali. In the spring of 1254 Kublai turned back to Jingzhao and left Urankhadai in Yunnan as commander of the armies, with the task of pacifying the White and Black tribal groups that had not yet submitted. His force had Mongol cavalry as its backbone, with infantry, craftsmen and engineers drawn from the Chinese territories, organised in the usual layers of thousand-household and hundred-household units, and the siege train kept up by attached engineering crews. On the Dali side was the Duan state of the Bai people, with Duan Zhixing as king in name while the real power sat with the Gao clan of the chancellor: Gao Taixiang handled the central government, and his clansman Gao Sheng led the tribal troops of the Luobu prefecture. Dali drew its soldiers from the armed contingents of the Baiman and Heiman tribes, with war elephants and crossbowmen among them, and Aizai, that is Tuodong, on the eastern shore of Dianchi was the military hinge of Dali in eastern Yunnan. On the same front the western column was grinding down the fortified settlements of the Baiman one by one, and the stronghold of Bankonghe, perched between mountain and river, fell only after its water supply was cut. Aizai stood on the edge of Dianchi with water on three sides, so that Dali had the whole lake for a moat: the defence was anchored on the water, and the first question of the siege was whether the besiegers could cross it and make a landing.
people: 核心人物是蒙古一方的兀良合台。他是速不台之子，本次征滇擔任西道主將，攻下大理城後留滇總督軍務；押赤城一役由他定計、由他指揮攻城，又在攻乾德格城時病倒，把指揮權交給兒子阿朮。阿朮在中文史料中又寫作阿珠，是夜襲押赤城的主將，率精銳由城隙潛入亂斫，隨後又以二百善射騎兵四面進擊、環城立砲而破乾德格城；日後他成為元軍在四川、襄陽與釣魚城戰線上的主將之一。蒙古統帥忽必烈於1253年秋發動此役，先遣使諭降大理，卻因使者被殺而震怒，一度要屠城，經姚樞、僧子聰、張文謙力諫才止，姚樞裂帛書寫止殺之令分號街陌；大軍北返後，他留下劉時中為宣撫使，與兀良合台同治雲南。大理一方，國主段智興（一作段興智）從頭到尾只是傀儡，決策出自相國高泰祥；高泰祥夜遁後在姚州被斬，族人高昇領羅部府諸部兵拒戰，於夷可浪山下被大敗。白蠻首領阿達喇死守半空和寨，摩娑蠻主索和爾圖則在金沙江畔迎降，兩種結局正好說明大理一方的邊地諸部對蒙古來去取捨不一。同期宋廷得到雲南失守的消息，士大夫的震動自不必說。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Mongol side was Urankhadai, son of Subutai, who led the western column of the Yunnan expedition and was left in the south as commander of the armies. Aizai was his operation in both senses: he planned it, he directed the siege, and when he fell ill before the last fortress, Qiangdege, he handed the command to his son Aju. Aju, written A-zhu in the Chinese sources, led the night entry into Aizai with picked troops who came through a gap in the wall and cut at the defenders in confusion; he then brought up two hundred skilled archers to attack from four sides, set stone-throwing engines around Qiangdege and took that town, and in later years became one of the commanders of the Yuan armies on the Sichuan, Xiangyang and Diaoyucheng fronts. The patron of the whole campaign was Kublai, who launched it in the autumn of 1253 and first sent an envoy to demand Dali's submission; when the envoy was killed the prince was furious and for a moment set on razing the city, and was held back only by Yao Shu, the monk Zicong and Zhang Wenqian, with Yao Shu writing the order to spare lives on a strip of silk and posting it street by street. When the main host went north he left Liu Shizhong behind as pacification commissioner to govern the province together with Urankhadai. On the Dali side, the king Duan Zhixing, also written Duan Xingzhi, was a puppet from first to last, and policy came from the chancellor Gao Taixiang; Gao Taixiang fled by night and was beheaded at Yao prefecture, while his clansman Gao Sheng, who led the Luobu tribal troops, was beaten in the field under the hill of Yikelang. Among the Dali frontier groups the outcomes were mixed: the Baiman chief Ada-la held his mountain fortress of Bankonghe to the end, while the Mosuo chief Suohaitu came out to welcome the Mongols on the banks of the Jinsha. On the Song side the news of the fall of Yunnan reached the court of the south, and the shock it produced among the literati needs no further comment.
kits: 這場戰役的卡面兵器是希臘火，但必須講清楚：希臘火沒有出現在押赤城的城牆下。它是七世紀東羅馬帝國的海上燃燒武器，裝在輕型巡洋艦的銅管噴射裝置上，674至678年阿拉伯大軍圍攻君士坦丁堡、717至718年海灣攻勢之中，帝國靠它和艦隊才守住了都城；配方被嚴格保密，敵手數度奪船仍無從得知成分，本卡兵器史所記「配方和船一起沉了」正指這件事。押赤城真正用上的是東亞體系的攻城器械：蒙古軍用漢地工匠造的石砲（礮、拋石機）轟擊北門，又以火攻焚燒城門與城樓，兩者都未能奏效；守城的白蠻、黑蠻諸部以弓弩、標槍應戰，並靠滇池水面作天然屏障。進攻序列還包括夜襲用的精銳步騎與填壕用的草束，投石機的同一套用法在同一戰線的半空和寨與乾德格城都出現過。火藥兵器此時尚未普及於元軍：突火槍最早的明確記載見於1259年婺溪之戰，比押赤城晚五年；西域來源的配重砲即回回砲，要到1271年攻襄陽前後才出現。所以本卡兵器同本場戰爭的關係是對照而不是參與：同一時代，兩個文明各自發展燃燒與攻城技術，卻在滇池邊沒有交集。
kitsEn: The piece on this card is Greek fire, and it must be said plainly: Greek fire was never present at the walls of Aizai. It was a naval incendiary of the seventh-century Eastern Roman Empire, mounted in bronze siphons on light dromons, and it was what let the empire hold Constantinople against the Arab armies of 674 to 678 and against the offensives of 717 to 718, the emperor himself taking ship to direct the defence. Its composition was a state secret, and several enemy captures of the vessels never revealed it; the note on this card that the formula and the ship went down together refers to exactly that. What actually fought at Aizai was the East Asian siege arsenal. The Mongols brought up stone-throwing engines built by Chinese craftsmen to batter the north gate and set fire to the gate and the gatehouse, and neither method worked; the Baiman and Heiman tribes of the garrison answered with crossbows and javelins and relied on the surface of Dianchi as a natural barrier. The assault sequence also included picked bodies of foot and horse for the night entry and bundles of grass for filling the ditch, and the same employment of stone-throwing engines can be seen in the same campaign at Bankonghe and at Qiangdege. Gunpowder weapons were not yet standard in the Yuan host: the earliest clear record of a tube firearm in the Chinese sources belongs to the battle of Wuxi in 1259, five years after Aizai, and the western counterweight trebuchet, the so-called Huihui pao, only appears around the siege of Xiangyang in 1271. The relation between this card's weapon and this battle is therefore a contrast rather than a participation: in the same century two civilisations developed incendiary and siege techniques separately, and the two systems never met on the shores of Dianchi.
tactics: 忽必烈的攻略大框架是分道並進加後方設站。1253年秋大軍抵達忒刺後分三路：兀良合台領西道兵攻白蠻，諸王素赫領東道兵，忽必烈自領中道直趨大理城；輜重留滿陀城，軍隊過大渡河後沿山谷行二千餘里至金沙江，用吹脹的革囊和木筏分批渡河，渡點在大理城北四百餘里。渡江後中道兵直薄大理城，段智興與高泰祥夜遁，兀良合台在姚州追斬高泰祥；忽必烈一度要屠城，經姚樞、僧子聰、張文謙力諫乃止。攻白蠻的西道軍另有一套辦法：半空和寨依山枕江牢不可拔，兀良合台不硬攻，而是先派人覘視，斷其汲道，再立砲攻之，寨兵出拒時以阿朮迎擊，寨破之後連帶阿蘇城一併拔下。大理城既下，忽必烈春三月班師，留兀良合台總督軍務。秋七月的押赤城之役，兀良合台先在羅部府大破高昇於夷可浪山，隨即進抵押赤城。攻城先用石砲摧毀北門，再縱火焚門，兩法皆不奏效，遂改用聲勢攻心：大震鼓鉦，進而作、作而止，反覆七日，使守軍不知虛實，疲於奔命；守軍困乏之際，趁夜五鼓以精銳由阿朮率領潛師躍入城中，亂斫之中守軍潰散。追擊至昆澤擒獲段智興，餘眾退入山谷，分遣裨將迂迴掩襲，約三日合圍；合圍後阿朮引二百善射騎兵四面進擊，兀良合台亦陷陣苦戰，攻拔外圍纖寨。末段攻乾德格城時兀良合台病倒，授權阿朮，阿朮環城立砲、以草填塹，待各軍集齊後先鋒搏戰城下而破之，示範了元軍「砲攻加填壕加總攻」的攻城套路。
tacticsEn: The framework of the operation was a three-column advance with a supply system left in the rear. In the autumn of 1253 the army reached Terchi and split: Urankhadai with the western column against the Baiman, the prince Suhe with the eastern column, and Kublai in the centre straight for the city of Dali. The baggage was left at Mantuo; after the Dadu the host marched more than two thousand li through the gorges to the Jinsha and crossed in batches on inflated leather bags and timber rafts, at a point four hundred li north of the capital. From there the central column came up to the walls of Dali; Duan Zhixing and Gao Taixiang fled by night, and Urankhadai caught and beheaded Gao Taixiang at Yao. Kublai was for a moment set on slaughtering the city and was held back by Yao Shu, the monk Zicong and Zhang Wenqian. The western column had its own method against the Baiman: the stronghold of Bankonghe, set between mountain and river, could not be taken by assault, so Urankhadai first scouted it, cut its water supply, brought up stone-throwing engines, and when the garrison came out to meet them met it with Aju; the fall of the stronghold brought the fort of Asu down with it. With the capital taken, Kublai returned north in the spring and left Urankhadai in command. In the seventh lunar month of 1254 came the operation at Aizai. Urankhadai first broke Gao Sheng at the foot of Yikelang near Luobu, then closed on the city. The artillery opened on the north gate and fire was set to it, and both failed; the method was then changed from force to deception, with the drums and gongs beaten in great noise, advanced and halted, advanced and halted, for seven days, so that the defenders could not tell what was coming and were worn out. When the garrison was spent, at the fifth watch of the night, Aju led picked troops in under the wall and into the city and cut at the defenders in confusion. The defenders broke; the pursuit ran to Kunze and Duan Zhixing was taken alive, the remnant scattered into the valleys, flanking columns were sent round to converge, and the ring was closed in about three days. Once closed, Aju brought up two hundred skilled archers to attack from four sides while Urankhadai fought in the thick of the line, and the outer fortified camp was carried. In the last phase, at Qiangdege, Urankhadai fell ill and gave the command to Aju, who set stone-throwing engines round the walls, filled the ditch with grass, and once the columns had gathered led the vanguard in against the town and took it, a demonstration of the Yuan formula of artillery, ditch filling and general assault.
data: 年份是確定的：1254年，蒙古帝國憲宗四年，大理國天定三年。《續資治通鑑》卷一百七十四把這一段記在宋理宗寶祐二年秋七月己巳條下，兩日後的己酉條又記大理思、播兩州守臣進秩，可見事在農曆七月，折合公曆約在1254年八至九月之間；本篇因此把月份取作八月。距離方面：軍隊過大渡河後沿山谷行二千餘里至金沙江，渡點在大理城北四百餘里；押赤城即今昆明，與大理城相距約三百三十公里；押赤城至昆澤約四十公里；羅部府即今楚雄一帶，夷可浪山在羅部府城北方向。時間方面：砲擊與火攻屢攻不克之後，鼓鉦虛張聲勢連續七日，夜五鼓發動夜襲，追擊之後分兵迂迴掩襲約三日合圍，攻乾德格城則待各軍集齊而後總攻。兵力方面：忽必烈征滇大軍分三道，確數在《元史》與《續資治通鑑》均未詳載，一般認為是數萬之眾，留滇的兀良合台部只是其中一部；夜襲投入的是精銳小隊，總數未載；合圍後投入的射手為二百騎。守軍是高昇所領的羅部府諸部兵，數目亦無記載。押赤城三面環水、易守難攻，此點史籍有明文。
dataEn: The year is certain: 1254, the fourth year of Möngke's reign and the third year of the Tianning era of Dali. The Xu Buzhi Tongjian, volume 174, enters this episode under the seventh lunar month of the second year of Baoyou, on the day jisi, and the entry two days later, on jiyou, records the promotion of the officials of the Dali prefectures of Si and Bo, so the action falls in the seventh lunar month, corresponding to roughly August and September of 1254 in the Gregorian calendar; this account accordingly takes the month as August. As to distances: after the Dadu the host marched more than two thousand li through the gorges to the Jinsha, at a crossing four hundred li north of the capital; Aizai is present-day Kunming, about three hundred and thirty kilometres from the city of Dali; Kunze, where the king was caught, lies some forty kilometres from Aizai; Luobu prefecture corresponds to the Chu Xiong area to the west, with the hill of Yikelang beyond it. As to time: after the artillery and the fire had failed, the drums were sounded for seven consecutive days, the night entry was made at the fifth watch, the flanking pursuit was given about three days to close the ring, and at Qiangdege the general assault waited until the columns had assembled. On numbers of men: the Yunnan expedition was split into three columns and the sources, the Yuan Shi and the Xu Buzhi Tongjian alike, give no exact figure, though it was plainly a host of several tens of thousands, and Urankhadai's force left behind in Yunnan was only a part of it; the night assault was made by a picked detachment of unspecified size, and the archers committed in the final encirclement numbered two hundred riders. The defenders were the tribal troops of Luobu under Gao Sheng, and no count of them survives. On the position, the record is explicit: the city lay on the lake with water on three sides, which is why it was hard to take.
cause: 起因有三層。第一層是蒙古帝國的戰略需求：憲宗三年，忽必烈奉命經略南方，志在迂迴南宋背後、從雲南方向夾擊宋境；大理扼滇中要衝，既是南宋在西南的盟友與屏障，又城坚糧足，不取下來就無法在南方站穩腳跟。1253年十一月忽必烈遣使諭降，段智興與相國高泰祥不從，蒙古使者被殺在大理城中，屍身後來由姚樞在城內搜出，此事成了直接開戰的理由：忽必烈聞訊震怒，揚言屠城泄憤，經姚樞、僧子聰、張文謙力諫才止。第二層是蒙古在南方的既定政策：白蠻、黑蠻諸部此時多不屬，兀良合台受命留滇，負責招撫未附諸部、建立站赤驛驛與闢地屯田，押赤城是這一政策的第一個硬骨頭。第三層是大理自身的內部矛盾：相國高氏把持政權，段氏國主空有虛名，高昇、高泰祥等高氏族人在羅部府一帶握有兵權，使中央與地方的裂痕在兵臨城下時暴露成兩路抵抗。押赤城一役因此也是一次典型的示範：以一部偏師，看能不能拿下大理的東都重鎮。
causeEn: The cause has three layers. The first is the strategic need of the Mongol Empire: in the third year of Möngke's reign Kublai was ordered to work out the southern front, his purpose being to turn behind the Southern Song and close on it from the direction of Yunnan. Dali barred the middle of the Yunnan plateau, was the Song's ally and shield in the southwest, and was a rich and well-walled country; until it was taken the Mongols had no secure footing in the south. In the eleventh lunar month of 1253 Kublai sent an envoy to demand submission; Duan Zhixing and the chancellor Gao Taixiang refused, and the envoy was killed inside the city of Dali, his body later found there by Yao Shu. That murder was the immediate occasion of the war. Kublai was angry enough to threaten to raze the city in revenge, and was only stopped by the remonstrance of Yao Shu, the monk Zicong and Zhang Wenqian. The second layer is the standing Mongol policy in the south: the Baiman and Heiman tribes were still largely unsubmitted, Urankhadai was ordered to stay in Yunnan, and pacifying the tribes, laying out the relay stations of the jači and opening fields were his assignment; Aizai was the first hard knot in that policy. The third layer lies inside Dali itself: the Gao clan had taken the government, the Duan king was a figurehead, and Gao Sheng and Gao Taixiang held armed power in the Luobu country, so that the fracture between court and hinterland opened into war in two separate columns as soon as an army stood at the gate. In that sense Aizai was also a demonstration: whether a detachment could take the great eastern stronghold of Dali.
impact: 押赤城之戰是蒙古征服雲南的關鍵一環。城破之前，蒙古只是打通了從雲南北上的通道；城破之後，段氏政權的軍事支點被拔除，大理國從此名存實亡，段智興被俘押送上都，段氏後來在元朝仍以世襲總管的名義統治故地，直到明代洪武年間才被徹底取消。押赤城與其後陸續平定的黑蠻、白蠻諸部，使元朝的統治自雲南延伸到貴州與廣西一側，站赤驛驛沿滇池東岸與南北山道鋪開，昆明自此由邊地城寨變成南方軍政中心，元朝後來在此設行省、置平章，把雲南正式納入帝國編制。這場勝利同時加深了南宋的恐懼：宋廷在兩浙、荊襄一路加緊防禦，襄樊方向的壓力隨雲南平定而急升，十九年後的1273年余卓、呂文德相繼失守襄陽，釣魚城則再守了二十五年。技術層面的影響更長久：元軍在押赤城與乾德格城用過的石砲、填壕與夜襲組合，正是1270年代他們在襄陽、樊城一線對宋城池反覆施壓的成熟套路；元軍手中由漢地工匠與色目工匠共同磨合的攻城技術，最終成為蒙古西征攻城能力的一環，也把東亞的砲術帶進西亞與歐洲的戰場。
impactEn: The Battle of Aizai was the closing piece of the Mongol conquest of Yunnan. Before the city fell, the Mongols had only opened a road into the north of the province; after it fell, the military base of the Duan state was gone, Dali survived as a name rather than a power, Duan Zhixing was carried off to the Mongol court, and the Duan line continued under Yuan rule as hereditary commissioners of the old kingdom until the Ming administration finally abolished it in the Hongwu era. Aizai, together with the Black and White tribal lands reduced after it, extended Yuan control from Yunnan towards Guizhou and Guangxi, and the relay stations of the jači ran along the eastern shore of Dianchi and the mountain tracks to north and south; Kunming changed from a frontier post into a southern military and administrative centre, and the Yuan later created the province there, making Yunnan a formal part of the empire. The victory deepened Southern Song alarm: the court tightened the defences of the southeast, the pressure on the Xiangyang line rose as Yunnan was settled, in 1273 Yu Zhuo and Lü Wende lost the city of Xiangyang, and Diaoyucheng held out for another twenty-five years. The technical legacy ran longer still. The combination of stone-throwing engines, ditch filling and night entry used at Aizai and Qiangdege was the mature routine the Yuan armies applied to Song cities at Xiangyang and Fancheng in the 1270s, and the siege craft refined by Chinese and Muslim engineers alike in Yuan service eventually became one of the tools of the Mongol western campaigns, carrying East Asian artillery practice into the battlefields of West Asia and Europe.
result: 結果是蒙古軍攻下押赤城，大理國的抵抗在滇池東岸被終結。步驟清晰可考：兀良合台大破高昇於夷可浪山之後進抵城下，石砲摧北門與火攻焚門皆不克，遂以鼓鉦連震七日、夜五鼓令阿朮潛師躍入亂斫的辦法攻破城門；守軍大潰，蒙古軍追至昆澤，生擒大理國主段智興，餘眾退入山谷後被分兵迂迴，三日合圍，再由阿朮以二百善射騎兵四面進擊而潰散，纖寨隨後拔除。最後一段攻乾德格城時，兀良合台因病把軍權交給阿朮，阿朮環城立砲、以草填塹，待各軍集齊先鋒搏戰城下，遂破其城。從結果看，大理國主與高氏的抵抗武裝被清除，段智興被俘後押送蒙古本部，大理從與蒙古對抗的獨立政權，變成元朝的邊地總管轄地，押赤城則成為元軍在雲南的駐節與出發點，往後元軍由滇東下，經廣西、湖廣直趨南宋側背，襄陽與釣魚城的戰局由此而定。至於希臘火，它自始至終沒有出現在滇池邊；這場戰爭真正倚仗的，是石砲、火攻、鼓聲、夜襲與填壕這些東亞老技術，與同時代地中海上一種靠銅管噴射的燃燒武器毫無關係。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Mongol army took Aizai and that Dali's resistance ended on the eastern shore of Dianchi. The steps are clear in the record. After breaking Gao Sheng at Yikelang, Urankhadai closed on the city; the stone-throwing engines battered the north gate and fire was set to it, both without effect, and the decision was then taken to work on the defenders by drum and deception, with seven days of noise and a night entry at the fifth watch led by Aju, which broke the garrison. The defenders collapsed, the pursuit ran to Kunze and Duan Zhixing was taken alive; the remnant was driven into the valleys, flanked, closed in after about three days, and then broken by two hundred archers attacking from four sides under Aju, after which the outer fortified camp was carried. In the last phase, at Qiangdege, Urankhadai fell ill and gave the command to Aju, who set engines round the walls, filled the ditch with grass, and once the columns had gathered led the vanguard in and took the town. In outcome the resistance of the Duan king and of the Gao clan was broken, Duan Zhixing was carried to the Mongol court, and Dali passed from an independent state confronting the Mongols to a frontier district under Yuan commissioners, with Aizai becoming the garrison and the staging point of the Yuan armies in Yunnan; from there the Yuan armies moved east and south, through Guangxi and Huguang, toward the flank of the Southern Song, and the campaigns at Xiangyang and Diaoyucheng followed from that decision. As for Greek fire, it never appeared on the shore of the lake at all. What this siege really relied on was the stone-throwing engine, the fire, the drums, the night entry and the filled ditch, the old techniques of East Asia, and it had nothing to do with the burning fluid sprayed from a bronze tube in the Mediterranean of the same century.
